miniz 3.1.0 (MIT), commit 174573d60290f447c13a2b1b3405de2b96e27d6c:
- Upstream source files are unmodified.
- miniz_export.h is a locally generated empty static-library export macro.
- Build with MINIZ_NO_STDIO, MINIZ_NO_TIME, MINIZ_NO_ZLIB_APIS,
  MINIZ_NO_DEFLATE_APIS, MINIZ_NO_ZLIB_COMPATIBLE_NAMES.
  NO_DEFLATE automatically disables archive-writing APIs.
- Do not define MINIZ_DISABLE_ZIP_READER_CRC32_CHECKS.

SHA256 by Brad Conte (public domain), commit cfbde48414baacf51fc7c74f275190881f037d32:
- Standard string.h replaces the nonstandard memory.h include.
- Byte-to-word shifts explicitly cast to unsigned WORD before shifting to
  avoid signed integer left-shift undefined behavior.
- sha256_update loop index is size_t, matching its length argument.
- No algorithm or hash-output changes.

UPSTREAM_SOURCES.txt records downloaded original SHA256 digests and URLs.
